restaurant.subject: Quick question about {company_name}'s delivery
restaurant.prompt_template: Write a personalized cold email for a restaurant owner about SMS marketing for repeat orders and delivery. Reference: {insights}. Highlight how local restaurants see 30% more repeat visits with SMS loyalty programs.

vet.subject: Appointment no-shows at {company_name}?
vet.prompt_template: Write a personalized cold email for a vet clinic owner about automated SMS appointment reminders to reduce no-shows. Reference: {insights}. Mention that clinics typically reduce no-shows by 40% with automated reminders.

dermatologist.subject: Patient engagement at {company_name}
dermatologist.prompt_template: Write a personalized cold email for a dermatologist about patient retention tools and automated follow-up care reminders. Reference: {insights}. Focus on how skin care practices increase patient LTV with post-treatment check-in sequences.
